_comment: Memory consolidation daemon configuration — Workstream 1: Agentic Semantic Memory Layer

supersession.description: Mark INFERRED observations as prov:wasInvalidatedBy when a newer MEASURED observation exists for the same entity. Default retention: 30 days before eligible for supersession.

temporal_compression.description: Aggregate point MEASURED observations older than 90 days into summary records per entity + record_type, reducing graph size.

conflict_escalation.description: Raise a ConflictEvent ObservationRecord when two non-invalidated MEASURED observations on the same entity carry contradicting value_text. Requires human review.

Confidential.description: Confidential-tier observations retained for 2 years (audit requirements)

Restricted.description: Restricted-tier observations retained for 7 years (regulatory requirements)
